name: LXRXXL ZYNTH
author: L'Cronx
summary: An experimental synth for Force and MPC: 19 coded voices on unconventional maths. A Lorenz-attractor CHAOS, a Hilbert-transform frequency SHIFTer, Euclidean rhythms and sine-wave melodies, and voices coded after the Yamaha DX7 (FM6), the Casio CZ (PHASE), the Minimoog (TRIO), Hammond tonewheels (WHEEL), NES / console chips (CHIP), Mutable Instruments Braids (MACRO) and Plaits (WAVE, PHYS), the LXR-02's drum voices (LXR TONE, LXR METAL) and the Erica Synths DB-01 bass via LXRXXL BAZZLINE (BAZZ), plus ANALOG, FM4, VOICE, GRAIN, NOISE, DRONE, TEXTURE and FX. Eight tracks, each voice with 20 controls and 8 starter sounds, an LXR-02 style sequencer with a melodic STEP RANDOM and a voice-aware SOUND RANDOM, a tape/digital delay, an 8-track mixer, presets; four pages of artwork by Suns Kiefer.
